header.title: Better Communication Across Cultures at Work
header.subtitle: Helping international teams and local staff communicate and collaborate effectively across cultures
header.description: Practical, discussion-based workshops that enhance communication and collaboration in multicultural workplaces and international business. I help individuals and teams build the skills and awareness needed to work more effectively across cultural boundaries.

image.alt: Genevieve, intercultural communication trainer, smiling outdoors among spring blossoms

about.title: About
about.body: I am an intercultural trainer specialising in communication and collaboration in multicultural workplaces. I work in higher education and with companies. Through my teaching and training I support individuals and teams to reflect on cultural differences and develop practical strategies for better collaboration.

image.alt: Genevieve collaborating during a cross-cultural communication workshop in a modern office.

credentials.text: Master's degree in Adult Learning in Global Change
Post Graduate Diploma in Intercultural Competence

items.text: Communication and collaboration in multicultural teams

items.description: Delivered at your organisation and tailored to your team's goals, challenges and workplace context.
Interactive live workshops for distributed or international teams, wherever they are based.
Flexible durations with half-day and full-day workshop options to suit your objectives and schedule.
